updateserver.name: Apps
updateserver.desc: Install WordPress, an OpenCart shop or Snipe-IT (IT asset management) into one of your websites in a few clicks, or deploy your own app from Git (GitHub, GitLab, any Git server, private ones with a deploy key): the panel makes its database, installs it as your own account, and a Git app is deployed again with one click or when you push. No setup page is ever left open on the internet.
